_comment: GRIM popup sprite animation presets. Edit freely; the engine reloads this on startup. 'easing' is one of: linear, easeInCubic, easeOutCubic, easeInOutCubic, easeOutBack, easeInBack. 'meshCache' optionally points to a baked geometry-node clip (.gmc) in this folder, produced by tools/blender/bake_popup_mesh_cache.py.
